testsuite.name: ai.storyfork.content.world.InitialWorldAnalysisPostgresTest

testcase.name: Neo4j success and failed PG finalization retain IDs block writers and recover after restart()
held rejected and old decisions cannot apply and remaining candidates become stale after partial success()
process death expires on read and changed basis remains stale without a new call()
review history is append only idempotent owner bound and persistent()
concurrent duplicate runs once outside lock and survives lost reply and restart()
approved additions preserve entities original relations and confirmed version with durable receipt()
invalid outputs timeout transport loss and rollback never leave partial candidates()
late response is never completed and lost commit acknowledgment returns persisted result()
concurrent reviews serialize and failed inserts leave no partial history()
failures around real Neo4j commit and PG acknowledgement resume the same application concurrently()
